# Danijel Golubović

> Power BI and Data Analyst based in Belgrade, Serbia. Builds Power BI dashboards, SQL analyses and automated reporting for finance, operations and executive teams. Open to full-time, part-time, remote or hybrid roles (European hours), plus freelance and consulting projects.

## Summary
- 5+ years in data, reporting and project controlling across 4 industries (betting and gaming, logistics/postal finance, SaaS, digital agency/PMO).
- Strongest area: end-to-end Power BI delivery: Power Query, data modelling (star schema), DAX, dashboard design and business KPI implementation.
- Connects data structure with business meaning: what a metric means, how it is calculated, and how stakeholders should act on it.
- Target roles: Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Power BI Developer, Finance Data Analyst.
- Best-fit domains: finance, SaaS, operations, commercial analytics, project reporting, KPI-heavy management reporting.

## Experience
- MaxBet, Senior Data Analyst (07/2026 – present): Power BI reporting for sportsbook, slots, bingo and loyalty across Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro; multi-country sportsbook dashboard suite (GGR, NGR, margin, actives, ARPU, WoW variance) with a KPI data dictionary; complex SQL on Amazon Redshift reconciling CMS slot, bingo and terminal data; Power BI competitive intelligence map (Deneb/Vega, 340+ locations); Power BI governance (RLS, scheduled refreshes, workspace audits, data quality).
- Österreichische Post AG, Finance Data Analyst (03/2026 – 07/2026): financial KPI dashboards, automated financial reporting with Power BI, Power Query and Excel; SQL extraction; variance analysis, profitability, budgeting and forecasting support.
- Virtuozzo, Power BI Manager (10/2025 – 03/2026): led end-to-end Power BI implementation and adoption; SaaS KPI dashboards (MRR, churn, CAC, growth); integrated Salesforce, ERP and SQL sources; BI enablement and self-service training.
- Merkle DACH, Medior Project Management Officer (05/2022 – 10/2025): automated Excel reporting suites and Power BI dashboards for project health and financials; Dynamics 365 analysis of contracts, costs and timesheets; reporting transparency via Jira and Confluence.
- Green Trust Consultancy, IT Manager (04/2021 – 05/2022): reporting tools and data structures, automation of manual data entry, data quality, cloud migration and cybersecurity.

## Services (freelance and consulting)
- Power BI dashboard, end to end: data model, source connections, DAX with documented KPI logic, decision-focused design, scheduled refresh.
- Reporting cleanup and automation: replace manual Excel routines with Power Query and SQL pipelines and one trusted source.
- Power BI audit: model, DAX, performance, refresh, data quality and governance review with a prioritised fix list.
- KPI design and management reporting: KPI definitions, variance/budget/forecast views, executive summary and drill-down, hand-over documentation.
- Process: free 30-minute intro call, written scope and quote, build in iterations, hand-over with documentation and walkthrough.
